body:
Mirae Asset Venture, Atinum Investment, and Woori Venture win Korea Post’s 60 billion won domestic venture capital mandate.

Korea Post has chosen three local alternative investment managers for a 60 billion won (US$41 million) domestic venture capital fund mandate that was tendered out almost two months ago for its insurance unit.

Mirae Asset Venture Investment, Atinum Investment, and Woori Venture Partners won the tender.

The government postal agency announced the appointments on its website on September 22.

The venture capital fund will have a five-year investment period and invest in startups, small and medium enterprises, and high-tech innovators.
